data.situation:
The following week, Lin's group visited a small packaging factory. Behind a viewing window, empty boxes travelled along a conveyor belt towards a filling machine. The guide used the moving boxes to explain several industrial processes, from filling to inspection and packing. Lin had expected a single enormous machine to do everything, but the work was divided among stations. The factory belonged to an industry that made packaging for other manufacturing industries. A map beside the exit showed its vast network of suppliers and customers. Maya noticed that the process diagram included waste collection, not just finished products. The guide explained that production involved material and energy costs as well as sales. Lin began her visit report with the sequence she had actually observed. She kept the guide's claims about the wider network in a separate paragraph, since the map did not let her inspect every supplier herself. Visitor display
The conveyor belt links the filling and inspection stations. The diagram describes the industrial processes in this building. The supplier map shows a wider network serving several manufacturing industries; it is not a record of every visitor's direct observations. Lin: I expected an enormous machine, but each station has a separate job.
Guide: Yes. Watch a box move from one station to the next.
Maya: Does the map mean you have a vast network of customers?
Guide: It shows suppliers and customers together. Your report should make that distinction.

readingBlocks.en: The following week, Lin's group visited a small packaging factory. Behind a viewing window, empty boxes travelled along a conveyor belt towards a filling machine. The guide used the moving boxes to explain several industrial processes, from filling to inspection and packing. Lin had expected a single enormous machine to do everything, but the work was divided among stations. The factory belonged to an industry that made packaging for other manufacturing industries. A map beside the exit showed its vast network of suppliers and customers. Maya noticed that the process diagram included waste collection, not just finished products. The guide explained that production involved material and energy costs as well as sales. Lin began her visit report with the sequence she had actually observed. She kept the guide's claims about the wider network in a separate paragraph, since the map did not let her inspect every supplier herself.
readingBlocks.zh: 接下来一周，林的小组参观一家小型包装工厂。观察窗后，空箱子沿传送带移向灌装机。向导借移动的箱子解释从灌装到检查、包装等几项工业流程。林原以为一台巨大的机器包办所有工作，实际工作分布在不同工位。工厂所属行业为其他制造业提供包装。出口旁的地图显示庞大的供应商与客户网络。玛雅注意到，流程图不仅显示成品，还包含废料收集。向导解释，生产除了销售，还涉及材料和能源成本。林以亲眼观察的顺序开始写参观报告，把向导对广泛网络的说明另放一段，因为单凭地图，她不能检查每一家供应商。

glossary.note: 本事件指制造商品的行业；the packaging industry。
glossary.example: The factory belonged to the packaging industry.

externalEvidence.definition: the people or companies engaged in a particular kind of commercial enterprise

glossary.note: 可数名词；along / onto a conveyor belt，复数 conveyor belts。
glossary.example: Empty boxes travelled along a conveyor belt.

externalEvidence.definition: a moving belt that transports objects (as in a factory)

glossary.note: 复数名词短语；manufacturing 修饰 industries。
glossary.example: The network serves several manufacturing industries.
glossary.exampleZh: 该网络为多类制造行业提供服务。

glossary.zh: 工业流程；工业生产过程
glossary.note: 复数名词搭配；本例是生产步骤，不是历史进程。
glossary.example: The guide explained several industrial processes.
glossary.exampleZh: 向导解释几项工业生产流程。

externalEvidence.definition: a systematic series of mechanical or chemical operations that produce or manufacture something

glossary.note: 形容词强调尺寸或数量很大；an enormous machine / an enormous cost。
glossary.example: Lin had expected a single enormous machine.
glossary.exampleZh: 林原以为是一台巨大的机器。

externalEvidence.definition: extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree- Walter Lippman

glossary.note: vast + area / network / amount；本句强调网络覆盖广。
glossary.example: The map showed a vast network of suppliers and customers.
glossary.exampleZh: 地图显示庞大的供应商与客户网络。

externalEvidence.definition: unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope- W.R.Inge

retrievalPrompts.function: Boxes moving past the factory window
retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell a classmate how the boxes move through the factory.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向同学描述箱子如何移动。
acceptableAnswers: Empty boxes move along a conveyor belt to the filling machine, then pass through the inspection station.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: conveyor belt 是传送带这个物件；along a conveyor belt 描述沿它移动。题目问移动过程，灌装与检查的先后比增加机器细节更有用。
checks: 把移动物件写为空箱子，而不是成品或行李。
说明箱子沿传送带移向灌装，再到检查工位的顺序。
让 along 或其他表示沿线移动的结构与 conveyor belt 搭配。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可用其他自然动词表达移动，也可分成两句。须保留空箱子、传送带及灌装到检查的流程；不要求说明未知的速度或机器型号。

retrievalPrompts.function: Boxes moving past the factory window
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the relationship between the factory and the industries it serves in a report sentence.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 为报告写一句说明工厂与行业的关系。
acceptableAnswers: The packaging industry supplies materials to several manufacturing industries.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: industry 在这里是生产行业；manufacturing 修饰 industries，表示制造行业。说明谁向哪些行业供应包装，能把供给方与服务对象交代清楚。
checks: 指出工厂所属的是包装行业。
说明包装行业向其他制造行业提供包装或材料。
区分单一行业 industry 与多个服务对象 manufacturing industries。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可从该工厂或整个包装行业起句，包装、包装材料等符合原文的表述均可。须保留包装供给方与其他制造行业的关系；不要求沿用参考句的主语。

retrievalPrompts.function: Boxes moving past the factory window
retrievalPrompts.cue: Distinguish the machinery you observed from the wider network shown on the map.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 区分你观察到的机器和地图展示的网络。
acceptableAnswers: I observed several industrial processes rather than one enormous machine. The map showed a vast network beyond the building.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: industrial processes 指生产步骤；enormous 可修饰机器尺寸，vast network 强调网络范围广。地图提供的网络信息与亲眼看到的工位不同，报告宜交代各自来源。
checks: 说明现场观察的是多个生产工位或工业流程。
指出更广泛的供应商与客户网络来自地图展示。
若提到一台巨大机器，把它标为先前预想；不把地图上的网络当成已亲自走访的现场观察。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可分别说明先前预想、现场观察和地图内容，也可合并表达。须保留多工位实际情况与地图上的广泛网络；不能把地图写成亲自走访每家供应商的记录。

transferPrompt.function: Boxes moving past the factory window
transferPrompt.cue: At an airport, describe the baggage conveyor to a friend using the objects you see there.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 机场行李区也有传送带，向朋友描述该物件而不沿用工厂产品。
acceptableAnswers: Our suitcases came along the conveyor belt. We waited beside it until we recognised our bags.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 机场里同样可用 along/on the conveyor belt 描述行李所在位置或移动路线。迁移时变的是场景中的物件，传送带这一搭配仍然成立。
checks: 使用机场行李区的物件，如行李箱或行李。
说明行李沿传送带移动或到达取件处。
将 conveyor belt 用作可数物件名词，不沿用工厂灌装流程。
transferPrompt.answerRangeZh: 可描述行李出现、移动或等待取件，不必保留“认出自己的行李”这一参考细节。须明确机场行李与传送带的关系；无需编写航班或箱子颜色。
